column1: #  Figure S2 of Barros-Reguera et al. 2025, DOI 10.1186/s13068-025-02675-w (PMC12306115).
#  Transcribed by eye from the figure image (word/media/image2.jpeg). NOT machine-extracted.
#  This file records the FIGURE AS PUBLISHED. It is deliberately not reconciled with our own
#  alignment of the 19 sequences; the 15 discrepancies are tabulated in CALIBRATION_MATRIX.md 3.1.
#  Verify before any load-bearing use. Caption, verbatim:
#    "Structure-based sequence alignment for active site residues retrieved from 3DM. Residues were
#     selected based on the catalytic center of HspUPO. Residue numbering corresponds to HspUPO ...
#     the structural location of each residue for clade V is described, with labels corresponding
#     the aliphatic pocket (AP), the entrance (E), the catalytic pocket (CP), and the acid-base pair:
#     Glu180 for all UPOs, and His110 in short UPOs and Arg173 in long UPOs (Clade I)."
#  '-' = no residue at that column. Lowercase 'y' is as printed in the figure.
#  LOCATION row is the paper's own assignment, defined for Clade V.
